caseNameFull: Don Lacy, as Liquidating Agent of the Oklahoma City National Bank, in Error v. Mollie Ezzard
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Oklahoma.
attorneys: Mr. W. F. Wilson and Mr. Enoch A. Chase for plaintiff in error., Mr. Harvey R. Winn, Mr. Henry E. Asp and Mr. Henry G. Snyder for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed with costs upon the authority of: (1) Chemical National Bank v. Hartford Deposit Co., 161 U. S. 1; Capital National Bank v. First National Bank of Cadiz, 172 U. S. 425; Union National Bank v. McBoyle, 243 U. S. 26. (2) Kansas City Southern Ry. Co. v. Albers Commission Co., 223 U. S. 573, 591; Creswill v. Knights of Pythias, 225 U. S. 246, 261; Norfolk & Western Ry. Co. v. West Virginia, 236 U. S. 605, 609-610. (3) Southern Pacific Co. v. Schuyler, 227 U. S. 60l, 611-612.
